name: Kamikawa Saya
source:
Hobbies: Watching films and romance dramas
Likes: Memories of [url=/c64279]Haruta[/url], creamy confectioneries
Dislikes: Insects, parsley

Houjou Gakuen's student council president and [url=/c69312]Wakana's[/url] younger sister who is kind and friendly to everyone around her, except Haruta, whom she treats coldly. She obediently goes around her [url=https://vndb.org/c77699]father's[/url] wish to merge the two schools, but in reality, is against the merging and joins the merger petition group.
Just what are her real intentions?
